limitations: Restricted to DFA inputs with a syntactically explicit identity neutral letter. It does not classify constant-circuit membership for arbitrary regular languages without a neutral letter, and the short proof leaves a material folklore risk despite targeted searches finding no prior arbitrary-DFA classification.
provenance: A deterministic-presentation complexity refinement of the neutral-letter constant-circuit characterization: semantic alphabeticity can be checked in NL without minimization and is NL-hard even with a fixed ternary alphabet and an identity transition letter.
record_title: Neutral-letter constant-circuit membership is NL-complete for arbitrary DFAs
